entities.name: Ealhmund of Kent
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ealhmund was King of Kent in 784. He was probably the father of King Ecgberht who was King of Wessex from 802, and who conquered Kent in the 820s. Ecgberht was the grandfather of King Alfred the Great.
